source: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual Volume 2 opcode and operand-encoding tables
notes: This database describes legacy 32-bit encodings used by the current XWASM CPU foundation.
Opcode bytes are exact fixed bytes; ModR/M fields and immediate/displacement fields are described separately.
A future decoder may compile this data into lookup tables rather than interpreting JSON for every guest instruction.
